name: AU-rich element mRNA destabilization by TTP, BRF1 and KSRP
rationale: All three members are ARE-binding proteins that destabilize mRNA; naming TTP/BRF1/KSRP separates the theme from the AUF1/HuR confusable and from decapping, deadenylation and stress-granule neighbours.

qualifier: in EGFR, ERBB2 and ERBB4 signaling
name: SHC1 and GRB2 adaptor events in ERBB receptor signaling
rationale: Every member is a SHC1 or GRB2 docking event downstream of an ERBB-family receptor, whereas the confusables centre on PI3K, PLCG1, GRB7, GAB1 or ligand/dimer-level ERBB signaling.

core: Extracellular ligand sequestration restraining Nodal signaling
name: Extracellular ligand sequestration restraining Nodal signaling in left-right patterning
rationale: Members describe extracellular trapping of ligands (BMP, Nodal) that negatively regulates Nodal signaling and lateral-mesoderm left-right asymmetry, unlike the broader BMP/TGF-beta SMAD, organ-asymmetry, somitogenesis and endothelial confusables.

name: PTEN-AKT signaling regulation and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Most members regulate PTEN stability, localization and translation or AKT/TSC/TORC2 output, alongside nuclear and cytosolic inositol (pyro)phosphate synthesis; the PTEN/AKT arm is what the pyrophosphate and serine-phosphorylation confusables lack, though the PAK-2p34 members fit only loosely.

name: Nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis for dolichol-linked N-glycosylation
rationale: Members make UDP-GlcNAc and UDP-/dolichyl-phosphate-glucose feeding N-glycan precursor assembly (GFPT1, ALG14 myasthenic syndromes), distinct from sialic acid, GPI-anchor and N-glycan trimming confusables.

core: Lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 oxylipin metabolism
name: Lipoxygenase and P450 oxylipin metabolism including pro-resolving mediators
rationale: Members cover leukotrienes, HETEs, EETs, hepoxilins, lipoxins, resolvins, protectins and maresins plus P450 omega-oxidation of fatty acids, whereas confusables are dominated by cyclooxygenase prostanoid synthesis and prostanoid receptors.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis and bone marrow hemopoiesis
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, division and differentiation and bone-marrow cell number and development, unlike confusables about thymic T-cell development, lineage-specific differentiation or pluripotent stem-cell maintenance.

name: Autophagosome assembly and autophagosome/late endosome-lysosome fusion
rationale: Members regulate phagophore/autophagosome assembly and maturation and the fusion of autophagosomes, MVBs and late endosomes with lysosomes, combining what the endocytic/phagosome-fusion and selective-autophagy confusables each lack.

name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, turnover and tRNA maturation
rationale: Members cover post-transcriptional processing, modification and stability of mitochondrial RNAs, mitoribosome assembly and nuclear/mitochondrial tRNA end processing and transport, whereas confusables add mtDNA replication, mitochondrial transcription and translation or pseudouridylation.

name: Glucagon-PKA fasting control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride metabolism
rationale: Members describe glucagon/PKA, PDE3B and AMPK signaling that tunes gluconeogenesis and triglyceride turnover under fasting or caloric restriction, unlike glycogen, LXR lipogenesis, insulin/adiponectin and ChREBP glucose-sensing confusables.

name: Dendrite and filopodium actin remodeling via BDNF-TrkB and EphB
rationale: Members link BDNF/NTRK2, EphB and RHOF/RAC1 signaling to actin, filopodia, dendrite arborization and spine shape, whereas confusables emphasise NMDAR-RAC1, PSD maintenance and structural synaptic plasticity.

qualifier: of mRNA, tRNA and ribosomal subunits
name: Nuclear export of mRNA, tRNA and ribosomal subunits
rationale: Most members are export of mature mRNAs, tRNAs and pre-ribosomal subunits through the nuclear pore, unlike confusables about RNA processing/decay, Pol I/III transcription or NPC assembly and protein import.

core: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor binding and resistance
name: PDGFR mutant tyrosine kinase inhibitor binding and resistance
rationale: All members concern TKI binding and drug-resistant PDGFR mutants; the receptor PDGFR distinguishes the theme from KIT and FLT3 counterparts.

name: Phagosome acidification and ion control against intracellular mycobacteria
rationale: Members describe phagosome acidification, phagolysosome fusion, PMN phagocytolysis and ion/iron competition at the Mtb-host interface, whereas confusables cover broader Mtb immune evasion or neutrophil granule cargo and peptide transport.

qualifier: face, palate, ear and pharyngeal glands
name: Face, palate and pharyngeal-derived gland development
rationale: Members are face, palate, outer ear and viscerocranium morphogenesis plus thymus, parathyroid and thyroid (and spleen) development, distinct from outflow-tract, trachea, exocrine-gland, inner-ear and limb confusables.

name: ERBB2 mutant resistance to targeted ERBB inhibitors
rationale: Members are ERBB2 kinase- and TMD/JMD-mutant resistance to TKIs and trastuzumab plus drug inhibition of overexpressed ERBB2, while confusables cover oncogenic signaling of RTK mutants or TKI resistance in KIT, PDGFR and ALK.

name: Cholinergic neuromuscular transmission and clostridial neurotoxin action
rationale: Members span acetylcholine synthesis, choline uptake, release and nicotinic receptors at the neuromuscular junction plus botulinum/tetanus toxins blocking release, unlike muscarinic/serotonin GPCR, NMJ assembly and GABA/glutamate transport confusables.

core: RNA polymerase I and III transcription
name: Elongation and termination of RNA polymerase I and III transcription
rationale: Members are elongation and termination of Pol I (with 5'-ETS rRNA processing) and Pol III transcription, whereas confusables centre on promoter opening, initiation and rRNA expression control.

qualifier: by fatty acids and autonomic transmitters
name: Fatty acid and autonomic control of islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members regulate insulin and glucagon secretion via free fatty acid and HCA receptors, intracellular fatty acid metabolism, GLP-1, acetylcholine and adrenergic inhibition; adrenergic and fatty-acid metabolism members distinguish it from incretin/calcitonin-receptor confusables.

name: Intracellular cobalamin metabolism and propionyl-CoA catabolism defects
rationale: Members are cellular cobalamin processing and its disorders (MMACHC, MMADHC, MMAA, MMAB, MUT, MTR) tied to propionyl-CoA catabolism, unlike confusables about dietary cobalamin uptake/transport or branched-chain acyl-CoA disorders.

core: JNK and p38 stress kinase cascade regulation
name: TAK1-driven JNK and p38 stress kinase cascade regulation
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate JNK/p38 stress-activated cascades including TAK1 and ALPK1 activation, whereas confusables focus on upstream TLR/NOD receptor routes or AP-1 and ERK feedback.

core: Oxidative metabolism of amines and phytochemicals
name: Flavin monooxygenase and P450 oxidation of amines and phytochemicals
rationale: Members oxidise nucleophilic amines (FMO3/TMAU, CYP1A2 N-hydroxylation) and plant-derived alkaloids, terpenoids and phenylpropanoids; FMO members distinguish it from general xenobiotic, sulfonation and acetylation confusables.

core: Presynaptic neurotransmitter release and reuptake regulation
name: Regulation of neurotransmitter release, reuptake and spontaneous transmission
rationale: All three members modulate synaptic neurotransmitter availability (secretion, uptake, spontaneous release), unlike confusables on catecholamine transporters or synaptic vesicle recycling.

name: Membrane phospholipid scrambling and phosphatidylserine-mediated apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members cover aminophospholipid flipping/scrambling, PS exposure, apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment, and related membrane blebbing, repair and mechanical responses, unlike surfactant, ER lipid transfer and apical trafficking confusables.

name: Golgi organization and COPI, endosomal and lysosomal vesicle traffic
rationale: Members span Golgi assembly, COPI retrograde/intra-Golgi transport, TGN sorting to lysosomes and endosome-Golgi recycling, whereas confusables cover ER entry, COPII export or Rab prenylation and GEF activity.
